description: Change mailbox name or quota within the plan. No guest access. Members can read. Owners, admins and organization keys can manage email. The private service credential stays on the server. Mailbox passwords and message content are never returned.

quota_mb.description: Quota in MiB. Must fit the plan and current usage.
